Comment: Layer order from lowest to highest. A module may depend only on modules in lower layers, plus same-layer modules listed in AllowedSameLayer. Paths are relative to the DrsFramework root; the longest matching path wins. A layer with AllowSameLayer set skips the same-layer rule (used for External, whose vendor plugins keep their own module structure); its other rules still apply.
TestModuleComment: Modules whose names end with TestModuleSuffix may also depend on any module in their own plugin.
